name: Engraved Plate
decision: D15: B · Engraved Plate (owner, 2026-10-29; docs/decisions.md entry 18)

paper.use: Page background: chart paper by day, night chart by night

wash.use: Grouped backgrounds, chips, wells, and the tab bar's ground

line.use: Hairlines, borders, and the double rule of card frames; never text

ink.use: Body text, headings, and the double rule of the atlas plate: iron-blue ink

muted.use: Secondary text, captions, sources, small-capital labels, and the edge of faint ribbons

rubric.use: The one accent, the cartographer's blue: rubrics, initials, red-letter days, role labels, source marks, differences in compare, and the primary action

onRubric.use: Text and symbols on rubric fills

ribbon.note: Season markers (P2.5, P4.8): always beside the season's or colour's name, never colour alone, never a theme or a text colour. Most prayer books prescribe no colours, so the app labels them as custom. Ribbons marked edge fall below 3:1 against paper and are drawn with a hairline edge in muted.

contrast.note: WCAG 2 contrast ratios, computed 2026-10-29. AA needs 4.5 for text; 3 for ribbons (non-text). ColorContrastTests recomputes these from the compiled asset catalog.

serif.family: Cardo (SIL OFL 1.1, David J. Perry): Regular, Italic, Bold
serif.fallback: The system serif (New York) if a file fails to register; ✠ (U+2720) always falls back to the system symbol font
lacks: small capitals in Italic and Bold
serif.use: Liturgical text, Scripture, titles, headings, small-capital labels, and tab labels

interface.use: Buttons, settings, form controls, and source lines

display.use: The day's name on Today; screen titles

title.use: Office and section titles; the office on its card

rubric.use: Rubrics: instructions, never words to be said; in colour or italic by setting

initial.use: The initial that opens a prayer or section

eyebrow.use: Small-capital labels above headings and on plates

role.case: small caps, words as the book prints them
role.use: Role labels: Minister, Priest, Officiant, People, Answer

tab.use: Labels drawn by the app in the plate style (the system tab bar keeps its own)

pageNumber.use: Printed page numbers in the margin

sourceMark.use: The mark that opens a source sheet

action.use: The primary action: outlined in rubric, square

rule.note: Engraved rules. A card's frame is a double rule (two hairlines with a gap) in line; the atlas plate's frame is the same in ink; a title rule under an office title is a double rule in ink.

radius.note: Square corners throughout: the plate is engraved, not moulded. System sheets and the navigation layer keep their own shapes.
